title: Bibiya rowe zaro zaar
body:
Bibiya rowe zaro zaar
<<MINI>>
Hussain hussain x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Bibiya rowe zaro zaar, shezadiya rowe zaaro zaar, lut gaya karbal mein gharbaar, Hussain hussain x2
Ai aale nabi ki aur darbar, Hussain hussain x2
Zanjir mein jakra hai bimar, hussain hussain x2
Bibiya rowe zaaro zaar.
